# CompressTo20KB
> Free online image compressor. Compress JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC to exact KB sizes — 20KB, 50KB, 100KB. No upload, 100% private. Specialized tools for visa photos, passport photos, and platform-specific compression (Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram).
